events.title: 42nd Festival of Trees
events.addr: 125 W Jefferson Blvd, Fort Wayne, IN 46802
events.blurb: Decorated trees fill the 1928 movie palace with pipe organ music, youth choirs and dance on stage. Sunday 9–11 a.m. is reserved for sensory-friendly visits, and Friday's Breakfast with Santa still had tickets (Saturday is sold out).
events.blurbEs: Árboles decorados llenan el cine de 1928, con música de órgano, coros juveniles y danza en el escenario. El domingo de 9 a 11 a.m. está reservado para visitas adaptadas sensorialmente, y aún quedaban boletos para el Breakfast with Santa del viernes (el del sábado está agotado).

events.title: Wild Lights at the Fort Wayne Zoo
events.blurb: An evening walk through the zoo lit up for the holidays, open Friday through Sunday nights in November.
events.blurbEs: Un paseo nocturno por el zoológico iluminado para las fiestas, abierto de viernes a domingo por la noche en noviembre.
events.getThere: Free parking at the main entrance and at the Zoo Education Center, 600 Franke Park Dr.

events.title: Parkview Field Holiday Lights
events.blurb: A walk-through light show around the TinCaps' downtown ballpark. Tickets are needed for everyone 2 and older; gates open at 5:30 or 6 p.m. depending on the night.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido a pie entre luces alrededor del estadio de los TinCaps en el centro. Se necesita boleto a partir de los 2 años; las puertas abren a las 5:30 o 6 p.m. según la noche.

events.title: Festival of Gingerbread
events.addr: 302 E Berry St, Fort Wayne, IN 46802
events.blurb: Gingerbread houses and scenes made by local bakers, families and kids fill the old City Hall museum.
events.blurbEs: Casas y escenas de jengibre hechas por reposteros, familias y niños locales llenan el museo del antiguo ayuntamiento.

events.title: Eddie Griffin
events.blurb: Stand-up from the comedian and actor, with an early and a late show on Friday. Reserved seating.
events.blurbEs: Comedia del comediante y actor, con una función temprana y otra tarde el viernes. Asientos reservados.
events.getThere: Free parking in the lot along Bluffton Road and behind the theatre, with overflow at Foster Park Plaza to the west.

events.title: American Elton: Elton John Tribute
events.blurb: Bill Connors performs Elton John's hits in costume. General admission is standing room.
events.blurbEs: Bill Connors interpreta los éxitos de Elton John con vestuario. La entrada general es de pie.
events.getThere: Free parking in the lot along Bluffton Road and behind the theatre, with overflow at Foster Park Plaza to the west.

events.title: Fort Wayne Komets vs. Toledo Walleye
events.blurb: ECHL hockey rivalry on Saturday night.
events.blurbEs: Rivalidad de hockey de la ECHL el sábado por la noche.

events.title: Rival Sons
events.blurb: Blues-rock on the Domestic Bliss Tour, with The Blue Stones and The Velveteers opening. General admission is standing room.
events.blurbEs: Blues-rock de la gira Domestic Bliss, con The Blue Stones y The Velveteers como teloneros. La entrada general es de pie.

events.title: Holly Shopping in Downtown Fort Wayne
events.blurb: Small Business Saturday kicks off Saturdays of shopping at downtown boutiques, with trolley rides and deals at the Visitors Center.
events.blurbEs: El Small Business Saturday da inicio a los sábados de compras en las boutiques del centro, con paseos en tranvía y ofertas en el Visitors Center.

events.title: Promenade Park
events.addr: 202 W Superior St, Fort Wayne, IN 46802
events.blurb: The riverfront park downtown with a treetop canopy trail.
events.blurbEs: El parque junto al río en el centro, con un sendero entre las copas de los árboles.
